name: certificados_operation_failures
description: Falhas de emissao, reconciliacao, backup ou restore drill sem PII.
filter: jsonPayload.logger="certificados.metrics" AND jsonPayload.metric_kind="counter_delta" AND (jsonPayload.metric="emission_jobs_failed_total" OR jsonPayload.metric="emission_job_dispatch_failed_total" OR jsonPayload.metric="reconciliation_errors_total" OR jsonPayload.metric="backups_failed_total" OR jsonPayload.metric="restore_drills_failed_total")
